integrity: Computation from complete finite face-poset enumeration, integral acyclic discrete-Morse critical-cell certificate, exact signed top-dimensional cycle and 384 symmetry checks. Self-review only, no independent audit or verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact graph dimension four for dominance and dimension five for the independence-homology corollary only; no integral homotopy wedge splitting or equivariant topological splitting, no uniform formula for other dimensions. Published Alexander duality and suspension results are credited as prior work. Unindexed equivalent prior computation is possible.
title: Integral homology and hyperoctahedral symmetry of the four-cube dominance complex
